page.layout: One printed page: running head at top left, page number at top right. One main text column, with one marginal note in the right margin beside the first paragraph. Below the text: catchword at right, gathering signature at foot left.

main_text.p: rum parentum ceruicibus. Abolebatur ctiam, vbicunque repertum effet sacrum Volumen, & ipsi apud quos inuentum effet; malè peribant. Certè vix cogitatione assequi valeo, quid huius tyrannidis vel impietati vel crudelitati addi vllo modo potuit. Iudæi tamen à persona Antiochi temeranda abstinent, tantum Asmonei filius Mathias (quem Mattathiam appellat author Machabæorum) Appellem Regij exercitus ducem, & impietatis administrum trucidat, & in se non tam offensiuum quàm defen-siuum aduerfus tyrannum, (quem sol vnquam vidit efferatissimum teterri-mumque) & ipsius Antichristi (si ita loquiliceat) typum, bellum suscepit, publicè exclamans: {c}Si cui est cordi Re-ligionis incolumitas me sequatur.c Cap.8.
main_text.head: CAP. XIIII. De Salvatoris obedientia erga Principes & Magistratus.
main_text.p: Jam tandem ad ipsius Saluatoris aduentum deuentum est; huius itaque

page.notes: The reference mark before "Si cui" is a small raised mark, read as "c" to match the marginal note "c Cap.8.". The first letter of the second paragraph is a large initial "I", read as "Jam" (iam, per rule). The word "defen-siuum" and "Re-ligionis" carry printed hyphens at line ends. The first paragraph's text runs from the previous page and has no visible start on this scan, so it is treated as a continuation. The left-hand page edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
